author: D33pdikn
quote:
I'm about halfway to 60% finish with this game. This all should have just been DLC for se4. So many missed opportunities, there's all these cars all over the map why can't I drive them? When I respond to a last save how come I have a different amount of bullets? When I shoot a table, I see the debris fly for the air but the table is still there unmoved. I have a massive hard drive and they have this engine to show debris but no in game damage.  I'm going to be honest too, the world war II trope is really old. Why don't we have like Vietnam or Afghanistan or something?  I'm not saying it's not an important portion of History just we are ignoring other parts of it that could be great games. I don't want to have to be playing call of duty or rainbow six to be experiencing anything modern.... The characters during the movies and in between missions aren't that interesting either. I'm finding myself skipping cutscenes because I know it's blah blah blah, **** blah blah blah rinse repeat. The dialogue is awful, I understand it's a game about world war II and the **** but there's this thing called implied speech I don't have to keep hearing the word **** ever sentence. Beginning of the game maybe the beginning of part of the mission say **** two or three times and I pretty much got it. I know we're not fighting communist Russians which in all reality would probably be a more fun game. 

You could skip this game and play sniper elite 3 and 4 instead. I might give resistance a try but the way I feel about it right now very apprehensive. I'm giving it a 4 out of 10 only because giving it a three would be rude. The gameplay is still fun just like I said many missed opportunities.
